provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Vaelmyrith is centered at 65.987651, 36.153483 under Council Republic, with 40,897,000 people across 11 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Vaelmyrith occupies  sq mi /  sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory. Its province terrain is led by Mountain range, Deep cavern, Deep forest. Velkynwood and Sylthéra-Vael carry the mountain record: Velkynwood is a deep mountain settlement opening into forest, and Sylthéra-Vael is both deep mountain and built from the mountain side.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Draconic and Reptilian Races, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, Triton, Merfolk, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Obsidian Diadem, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Enkirael, Freyseth, Iskareth, Sigrananna, Bastveig, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 25 recorded four-province geography group links, including 22 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.
